name: White Tea
siboNotes: Plain white tea is SIBO-friendly and may have gentle anti-inflammatory properties. Avoid adding high FODMAP sweeteners or milk.
preparationTips: Brew with water heated to 175-185°F (80-85°C) to preserve delicate flavor
Steep for 2-4 minutes to avoid bitterness
Sweeten with maple syrup (1 tbsp max) or stevia if needed
Can be enjoyed hot or iced throughout the day
nutritionalHighlights: May support heart health and skin health
